detail: 태그를 제거한 결과가 원문과 다름 (모델이 텍스트를 고쳐 씀)
text: Police said Lo Piccolo had the upper hand because he had been Provenzano's right-hand man in Palermo and his greater experience won him the respect of the older generation of bosses as they pursued Provenzano's policy of keeping as low as possible while strengthening their power network.
